answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The nebula holds work receipts rather than names, so the whisper of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, converted to a slow vesting stream, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Reaching the ripple of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
